sd_property.conveyed_interest: exact share/portion the Sale Deed conveys, e.g. '1/2 undivided common share'
sd_property.property_identity: Plot/CTS/Survey number + locality of the conveyed property

transactions.chain_role: THE_SD | PREDECESSOR_TITLE | SUBSEQUENT_TRANSFER | DIVERGENT_BRANCH | ENCUMBRANCE | UNRELATED
transactions.portion: the exact share/portion of the property this entry covers, e.g. '1/2 undivided share', 'balance share with building'
transactions.explanation: plain-language explanation of this entry's role in the title story

title_story: Detailed, multi-paragraph plain-language narrative of how title to the conveyed share was built, detailing each transaction chronologically, acquisition links/gaps (including potential legal heir inheritance hypotheses), current ownership status, active encumbrances, and EC recency.

required_documents.date: DD-MM-YYYY of the transaction or event
required_documents.instrument_event: e.g. 'Sale', 'Agreement of Sale', 'Cancellation Deed', 'Earlier Sale Deed referred to in 2009 deed'
required_documents.parties_effect: 'Vendor → Purchaser; share; consideration', or whose acquisition is claimed for a gap row
required_documents.required_docs: the specific physical documents needed to conclude and verify this transaction
